invites.createError: Could not create the invite. Check your connection and try again.

invites.revokeError: Could not revoke the invite. Reload and try again.

password.totpExplanation: Enter the 6-digit code shown in your authenticator app.
password.recoveryExplanation: Enter one of your recovery codes. Each code works only once.
password.recoveryHint: Case and dashes do not matter.
password.useRecovery: Phone not at hand? Use a recovery code
password.useTotp: Use a code from the authenticator app
password.recoveryCodesLeft_one: A recovery code has been used up; {{count}} is left. If you have lost your phone, ask a maintainer to reset your sign-in.
password.recoveryCodesLeft_other: A recovery code has been used up; {{count}} are left. If you have lost your phone, ask a maintainer to reset your sign-in.

errors.network: Could not sign in. Check your connection and try again.
errors.totpInvalid: The code is wrong or has been used. Wait for the app to show the next code and try again.
errors.recoveryInvalid: The recovery code is wrong or has been used.
errors.expired: The sign-in has timed out. Enter your login name and password again.
errors.cannotSignIn: This account cannot sign in any more.

register.title: Register
register.noInvite: You need an invite link to register. Ask a maintainer of the circle for one.
register.invalidInvite: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
register.checkError: Could not check the invite. Check your connection and try again.

password.loginNameHint: 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, _ and -. For signing in; other members do not see it.
password.displayNameHint: The name your recommendations are signed with, up to 64 characters. Your login name if left empty.
password.totpExplanation: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app (such as Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Aegis or FreeOTP). Registering on this phone? Use the button below to add it directly, or type in the key. Then enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
password.qrTitle: QR code for the authenticator app
password.openApp: Add to the authenticator app on this device
password.codeHint: The app shows a new 6-digit code every 30 seconds.

errors.loginNameInvalid: A login name has 3–32 characters: lowercase letters, digits, _ and - only.
errors.loginNameTaken: This login name is taken. Choose another one.
errors.displayNameInvalid: A display name has at most 64 characters and no control characters.
errors.passwordTooLong: The password is too long (at most 128 characters).
errors.passwordIsLoginName: The password must not be the login name.
errors.codeInvalid: The code is wrong. Check that the app has this key, wait for the next code and try again.
errors.enrolmentExpired: The registration timed out (15 minutes). Submit again; you will then scan a new code, and can delete the old entry from the app.
errors.network: Could not submit. Check your connection and try again.

session.error: Could not check whether you are signed in. Check your connection and try again.

map.loadError: Could not load the list of cities. Check your connection and try again.
map.noCities: There is no city to show yet: a maintainer has to provide the basemap files of the cities first.

locate.unsupported: This browser cannot determine your location.
locate.denied: No permission to use your location. Allow it in the browser settings.
locate.outside: Your location is outside the map of every city.

map.noTiles: There is no basemap for {{city}} yet. It shows here once the server's operator has placed the city's basemap file (deploy/tiles.sh).

errors.cancelled: The passkey prompt was cancelled or timed out. Try again.
errors.address: Passkeys do not work at this address. Open the app at the address the invite link uses (for local testing: localhost, not 127.0.0.1).
errors.unsupported: This browser or device cannot use passkeys. Use a password and an authenticator app instead.
errors.unavailable: Passkeys are not available on this instance. Use a password and an authenticator app instead.
errors.failed: Something went wrong. Check your connection and try again.

register.loginNameHint: 3 to 32 characters: letters a–z, digits, _ and -. You cannot change it later.
register.displayNameHint: What other members see. You can leave it empty to use your login name.

errors.invalidLoginName: The login name must have 3 to 32 characters: letters a–z, digits, _ and -.
errors.invalidDisplayName: The display name can have at most 64 characters and no special control characters.
errors.loginNameTaken: This login name is taken. Choose another one.
errors.invalidInvite: This invite link is invalid or has expired. Ask the person who invited you for a new one.
errors.verifyFailed: The passkey could not be verified. Try again.
errors.exists: This device already has a passkey for this account.

errors.failed: Sign-in failed. The passkey may not belong to this instance, or the account is no longer active.

recoveryCodes.title: Save your recovery codes
recoveryCodes.explanation: If you lose your passkey, your phone or the authenticator app, sign in with a recovery code instead. Each code works once. Keep them in a password manager, or print them and keep them somewhere safe.
recoveryCodes.copyError: Could not copy. Select the codes by hand or download them.
recoveryCodes.shownOnce: The codes are shown only now: the server keeps only their hashes and cannot show them again.
recoveryCodes.confirm: I have saved these recovery codes

setup.title: Set up this instance
setup.loadError: Could not check the instance. Check your connection and try again.

code.intro: This instance has no maintainer yet. Enter the setup code, then name the instance and create the first maintainer; after that, people can only join with a maintainer's invite.
code.label: Setup code
code.hint: The server writes the setup code to its log when it starts (look for setup_code); you can also run osfm setup-code on the server. Only the code from the latest start is valid.
code.form: A setup code has 16 letters and digits, like XXXX-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX.
code.invalid: Wrong setup code. Use the one the server printed at its latest start.
code.network: Could not check the setup code. Check your connection and try again.

account.intro: Create your maintainer account. As for every member, two-step verification is required.

name.label: Instance name
name.hint: Shown at the top of the page and as the issuer of this account in authenticator apps; at most 100 characters. It is saved together with the maintainer.
name.required: Enter the instance's name (at most 100 characters).

cities.intro: The cities your circle cares about, at least one. Each city's basemap is one file in the server's tiles directory, named after the city's slug.
cities.noArchives: There are no basemap files on the server yet. You can add cities below and complete the setup now, and place the basemaps later.
cities.name: Display name
cities.noTiles: No basemap yet. In the OSFM directory on the server, run the command below to extract this city's basemap (if the data directory is not ./data, add its tiles directory as a third argument). Until the file is in place, the map shows “no basemap yet” for this city.

add.title: Add a city
add.name: New city's display name
add.slugHint: 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits or -; also the basemap's file name (slug.pmtiles).
add.bboxHint: minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat in WGS-84 degrees, for example 6.68,0.30,6.76,0.36. You can draw one on OpenStreetMap's export page.

errors.name: Enter a display name (at most 64 characters).
errors.slug: A slug has 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits or -.
errors.bbox: Write the bounding box as four numbers, minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat, each minimum below its maximum.
errors.none: Choose or add at least one city.
errors.invalid: The cities are not valid. Check their names, slugs and bounding boxes.
errors.network: Could not save. Check your connection and try again.

cities.nameHint: Saved with the maintainer; you can still change it here.

errors.codeInvalid: Wrong or expired setup code. Use the one the server printed at its latest start.
errors.done: This instance has been set up already.

rateLimit.wait_one: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} minute.
rateLimit.wait_other: Too many attempts. Try again in {{count}} minutes.
rateLimit.later: Too many attempts. Try again later.
